meta.pageTitle: Mai Quoc Viet – Full-stack Developer & Team Lead | Da Nang
meta.description: Mai Quoc Viet (maiviet283) – Full-stack developer & team lead in Da Nang. Co-founder of Haven, previously built VietDon. Python, Django, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL.

hero.lead: Full-stack developer in Da Nang. Leading a team at BNH Digital and building Haven.
hero.body: I design, ship and run production systems end to end with Python, Django, FastAPI and React. B.Eng. in Information Security & Computer Networks (VKU), originally from Kỳ Anh, Hà Tĩnh.
hero.caption: Mai Quốc Việt, Da Nang.

work.title: Learning from real systems and teams, then leading them to ship real products.

items.body: Australia-based software agency, remote. Lead a 3-person engineering team: turn client requirements into technical designs and schemas, plan sprints, and review every pull request — including AI-assisted code. Shipped 6 production web and mobile apps in 5 months; set the team's standards for automated tests, CI and OpenAPI docs; run production with Docker, Cloudflare, Sentry and zero-downtime blue-green releases.

Shipped features and bug fixes for the AttituX HR Platform (.NET) across authentication, profile and admin modules, plus internal admin tools. Worked in an Agile/Scrum team through pull requests, code reviews and issue tracking.

Built routing modules for a nationwide route-finding system in Japan (FastAPI, GeoPandas, pgRouting). Cut route computation from 33s to 1.2s (~27× faster), migrated services from sync to async in 3 days, and redesigned PostgreSQL schemas, indexes and queries to reduce latency.
Worked close to real infrastructure: routing, security fundamentals, and monitoring with Nagios and ELK Stack. This helped me see backend as a running system, not only code.

projects.title: Personal projects I use to sharpen backend, security and systems skills.

items.name: Network Intrusion Detection & Alert System
items.detail: A Python + Elasticsearch system that collects and analyzes security logs from Zeek, Nginx, and Django to detect abnormal behavior and send realtime alerts.
features: Detects DDoS, SQL Injection, directory brute-force, and login brute-force patterns
AI Advisor uses ChatGPT API to suggest mitigation actions for each threat
Notifier sends alerts and recommendations to administrators via Telegram

items.name: BookStore
items.detail: A book management API built with Django REST Framework, JWT, MySQL, Redis, and React TypeScript.
features: RESTful APIs for a book management system
Redis caching to reduce database load

items.name: Clothing Shop API
items.detail: E-commerce backend with auth, anti-spam, Redis cache, Gunicorn, and Nginx.
features: Backend API for an e-commerce flow
Security mechanisms: brute-force protection, anti-spam, and request validation
Production deployment with Gunicorn and Nginx

stack.title: I build a solid core, then finish it into a clear experience.
stack.beliefBody: Clear API contracts with OpenAPI, automated tests on every project, CI on every repository, zero-downtime blue-green deploys and Sentry watching production. I use AI to move faster, but every line still goes through careful review before merge.

products.title: Products I've built, the ones running now, and one I've closed.

items.name: Haven
items.tagline: On-demand home doctor visits and a health platform.
items.summary: Building the entire product solo: an Astro website (live), a 14-module Django REST API, an operations admin system for Haven staff, and a React Native app for patients and doctors (pre-release).
points: End-to-end care flow: radius-based doctor search, doctor KYC review, bookings with automated reminders, VietQR payments, and care plans with medication tracking for whole families.
AI food recognition with Gemini for calorie tracking, alongside a library of 566 exercises.
Hardened for health data: 2FA-protected admin, OTP and Google/Apple sign-in, presigned uploads to Cloudflare R2, Celery on 4 queues, blue-green deploys.

items.name: One Management System
items.tagline: Sales, accounting & tax SaaS for SMEs.
items.summary: Built the full system in about 3.5 months: a web app where SMEs and household businesses run their sales, plus an operations admin system for OMS staff. Launched in production in 11/2026.
points: Multi-tenant architecture: one account runs many businesses, and every business API is tenant-scoped to keep financial data isolated.
~50 modules: sales, e-invoicing, tax filing, finance, payroll, CRM, purchasing, logistics and an AI legal assistant — shipped as a web app and a Windows desktop app.
Email, e-invoice, reporting and scheduled backup jobs automated with Celery + Beat.

items.name: EightyTwenty
items.tagline: Back office, ordering app and POS API for a café chain in Australia.
items.summary: The Back Office System and the shared REST API behind the customer app, POS terminals and kitchen displays — running daily operations across 10 stores in Australia.
points: Ordering that is safe against retries and price tampering: server-side pricing and idempotent order creation.
Loyalty, gift cards, table booking, catering and push notifications; POS with PIN login, till shifts, refunds and a live order feed to kitchen displays.
Owner / manager / staff roles, an audit log on every write, and revenue reports by day, store, item and payment channel.

items.name: VietDon
items.tagline: Real-time donation platform for Vietnamese streamers.
items.summary: A personal product I built and ran for 9 months, reaching 200+ active users and about 12M VND in monthly revenue. VietDon stopped operating in 11/2026.
points: Pay2s QR payments with asynchronous processing on Celery.
Real-time donation alerts through Django Channels and WebSocket.
Redis caching, media on Cloudflare R2, deployed with Docker and Nginx.
